body: **This release brings:** `exithandlers` command to inspect glibc exit handlers, Linux kernel task introspection without typeinfo (`kstack`, `kseccomp`, `ksighand`, `knamespace`), glibc 2.43 heap inspection improvements, heap tracker allocation call sites (`track-heap --where`), a much richer `procinfo` output (netlink info, socket or pipe peers), vmmap being cached on macOS, LLDB fixes and many other! See below for screenshots and more info! Also, please [sponsor the project to let us keep improving](https://github.com/sponsors/pwndbg)! Thanks to everyone who made this possible! ---- ## Quick install Install Pwndbg portable on Linux or macOS (choose one line for GDB or LLDB): ``` curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf 'https://install.pwndbg.re' | sh -s -- -t pwndbg-gdb curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf 'https://install.pwndbg.re' | sh -s -- -t pwndbg-lldb ``` Homebrew package (macOS only; choose one line for GDB or LLDB): ``` brew install pwndbg/tap/pwndbg-gdb # only allows for remote debugging of ELFs brew install pwndbg/tap/pwndbg-lldb ``` Nix package manager (Linux/macOS; choose one line for GDB or LLDB): ``` nix shell github:pwndbg/pwndbg # this is pwndbg-gdb nix shell github:pwndbg/pwndbg#pwndbg-lldb ``` Other options: * Want specific distro and architecture package? [Check out setup docs](https://pwndbg.re/stable/setup) and download the specific asset below. * Want latest development version? See [install from source](https://pwndbg.re/stable/setup/#installing-from-source). ---- ## What's changed ### Breaking Changes * **The `mallocng-*`, `jemalloc-*` and `knft-*` commands are now subcommands** - use `mallocng dump`, `mallocng vis`, `jemalloc heap`, `jemalloc extent-info`, `knft list-tables` etc. instead of the old dash-separated names ([#3750](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3750)) * **`cyclic` output is now consistent with pwntools** - the generated de Bruijn sequence matches `pwn cyclic` ([#3801](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3801)) * Developer API: `pwndbg.aglib.disasm.arch` was renamed to `pwndbg.aglib.disasm.assistant` ([#3919](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3919)) ### New: `exithandlers` **Added the `exithandlers` command** (alias `exitfuncs`) - lists the currently registered glibc exit handlers by walking `__exit_funcs` and `tls_dtor_list`, demangling the `PTR_MANGLE`d function pointers and printing the `pointer_guard` cookie. Very handy when hijacking exit handlers during exploitation ([#3973](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3973), alignment fixes in [#3983](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3983)) ### Linux Kernel Debugging **Full support for debugging kernel tasks without typeinfo** - along with four new commands to introspect any kernel task ([#3647](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3647)): * `kstack [pid]` - display information about the stack of a task * `kseccomp [pid]` - display seccomp information of a user task * `ksighand [pid]` - display signal handlers of a task * `knamespace [pid]` - display namespaces of a task Other kernel improvements: * **Added the `percpu` GDB function** - to resolve per-CPU variables from `print`/`break` expressions ([#3950](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3950)) * **Added `v2p` and `p2v` GDB function helpers** - to convert between virtual and physical addresses inside expressions ([#3842](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3842)) * **Added support for breaking at the start of a JIT-compiled eBPF program** ([#3757](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3757)) * Page table scanning now reads `/proc/pid/mem` by default, which is much faster ([#3947](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3947)) * Kernel common structs are now loaded only when necessary, speeding up startup ([#3948](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3948)) * Added a kernel symbol lookup function decorator ([#3776](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3776)) * `slab_contains` now shows inuse/total object count on its own line ([#3830](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3830), [#3833](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3833)) * Added help to `slab` subparsers ([#3769](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3769)) * IDT entries are now iterated with a generator ([#3768](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3768)) * Kernel image downloads are parallelized and much faster ([#3972](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3972)) * LOTS of fixes ([#3971](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3971), [#4003](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/4003), [#3803](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3803), [#3940](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3940), [#3853](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3853), [#3785](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3785), [#3871](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3871), [#3918](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3918), [#3831](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3831)) ### Heap & Allocators * **Added glibc 2.43 heap support** ([#3744](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3744)) * **Added support for tcache large chunks since glibc 2.42** ([#3854](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3854)) * **Added `heap --count ` and address range limits** - `heap ` walks only the requested range, and both limits can be combined ([#3812](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3812)) * **The heap tracker can now annotate each event with its call site** - `track-heap enable --where` shows the nearest program symbol that triggered every malloc/realloc/calloc/free ([#3986](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3986)) * **Added `track-heap enable -r`** - to report offsets relative to the mapping instead of absolute addresses ([#3738](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3738)) * **Musl libc is now detected in statically linked binaries** ([#3798](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3798)) * Fixed a dead duplicate loop in `Tracker.malloc` ([#3997](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3997)) ### Process & Memory **`procinfo` now shows a lot more about file descriptors** - netlink socket protocol, portid and groups ([#3892](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3892)), the peer process for unix-domain sockets ([#3893](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3893), [#3993](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3993)), and pipe peers together with the read/write end of each pipe ([#3894](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3894)) * **Cleaned up and improved the `mmap`/`mprotect` commands** - better argument handling, address validity warnings and hints, plus `--quiet` and `--force` flags ([#4039](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/4039)) * **Replaced the system `readelf` with pyelftools** - so ELF parsing works for every architecture without external tools ([#3470](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3470)) * **Added `set vmmap-cache`** - vmmap is now persisted across stops on macOS ([#3913](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3913)) ### Disassembly & Context * **Unresolved conditional branches are now marked with a question mark** in the disassembly view ([#3906](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3906)) * **The disassembly view now indicates when the current pc is at a breakpoint** with a `b►` marker ([#3789](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3789)) * **Added `set telescope-pad-leading-zeroes on`** - to print pointer-aligned integers zero-padded to the pointer width in `telescope` ([#3902](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3902)) * **GDB's `print` command now shows values in hex** by default ([#3788](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3788)) * **Fixed shortcomings of `nearpc --function` compared to `disass`** ([#3823](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3823)) * Fixed addresses, symbols and other columns being truncated in the backtrace context ([#4042](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/4042)) * Fixed alignment issues in the context backtrace ([#3946](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3946)) and large frame offsets ([#3914](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3914)) * Fixed messed up stack repeating logic ([#3901](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3901)) * Fixed `IndexError` when `longest_history == 1` ([#3904](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3904)) ### `dt` Improvements **The `dt` command now handles bitfields, nested structs and flexible array members properly** - bitfields get sub-byte offsets (`+0x0000.1`), nested field offsets are printed recursively, and flexible array members are displayed ([#3876](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3876), [#3862](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3862), [#3814](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3814)) ### LLDB * **Command history and Enter-to-repeat now work on LLDB** ([#1374](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/issues/1374), [#3980](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3980)) * Allowed C++ symbol characters in symbol name validation ([#3987](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3987)) * LLDB + Hexagon no longer crashes immediately ([#3671](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3671)) * Fixed invalid color setting on LLDB ([#4036](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/4036)) ### Architectures * **Enabled RISC-V B extension disassembling** ([#3920](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3920)) * **Upgraded past Capstone v6 alpha 6** ([#3864](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3864)) * Added the IOPL eflag field ([#3834](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3834)) * Handle `ljmp` instruction target resolution for i8086 ([#3953](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3953)) * Fixed unsupported architecture `powerpc64le` ([#3827](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3827)) * Fixed the `vbar` register in AArch64, which should be `vbar_el1` ([#3869](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3869)) * Added register-name aliases to `read_reg` ([#3877](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3877)) ### General * **The pwndbg themes collection now lives in the main repository** - see the `themes/` directory, previously hosted in `pwndbg/pwndbg-themes` ([#3928](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3928)) * **`stepsyscall` can now step until a given syscall or condition** - `stepsyscall write` or `stepsyscall -c '$rdi==0'` ([#3564](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3564)) * **Added an optional count/length parameter to the windbg-style `dds`/`dps`/`dqs`/`kd` commands** ([#3961](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3961)) * **Invalid color names are now rejected** instead of silently breaking the output, on both GDB and LLDB ([#3949](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3949), [#4033](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/4033), [#4036](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/4036)), and a color decorator was implemented in `pwndbg.color` ([#4037](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/4037)) * **`gnureadline` is now optional** ([#3787](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3787)) * Added more tips ([#3891](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3891)) * Fixed Go type `direct_iface` resolution ([#3868](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3868)) * Fixed Ghidra decompiler integration out of bounds ([#3932](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3932)) * Fixed `profiler` subcommand being optional when it is required ([#3951](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3951)) * Fixed `OSError` parameter order in `get_file` ([#4021](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/4021)) * Fixed handling of GDB builds without debuginfod support ([#3867](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3867)) * `gdbinit` no longer triggers an early `pwndbginit` import ([#3964](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3964)) * Bumped GDB and LLDB used in our releases ([#3982](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3982), [#3794](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3794), [#4044](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/4044)) ### Internals & Housekeeping * Enabled a lot more ruff rulesets: flake8-bugbear ([#4014](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/4014)), PLE ([#3999](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3999)), PLR ([#3962](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3962)), FURB ([#3955](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3955)), SIM ([#3924](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3924)), PIE ([#3925](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3925)) and flake8-return ([#3923](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3923)) * Cleaned up `pwndbg.hexdump` ([#4030](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/4030)), `pwndbg.aglib.onegadget` ([#3942](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3942)), `pwndbg.color` naming ([#3941](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3941)) and `wrappers/readelf.py` ([#3850](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3850)) * Bumped Vermin to 1.8.0 ([#3883](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3883)) and pyelftools now that types were added ([#3930](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3930)) * Pinned GitHub Actions to commit SHAs ([#3958](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3958)) and fixed a number of flaky tests and Docker/CI caching issues ([#3957](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3957), [#3895](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3895), [#3872](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3872), [#3852](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/3852))
